find-jelenneth.title: Find Jelenneth or Learn Her Fate
find-jelenneth.summary: Search for Jelenneth, the missing daughter of Parker and Heldrith Laneworth. Rescue her, or learn her fate so her family can have closure.
objectives: Find and rescue Jelenneth, or learn what happened to her.
Return reliable news to her family.

three-items-for-nuanda.title: Three Items for Nuanda Nemere
three-items-for-nuanda.summary: Retrieve the three ritual ingredients Nuanda Nemere requested and bring them to her before she no longer needs them. The party achieved this quest on May 9, 406 PR.
objectives: Obtain an amethyst worth at least 50 gp.
Obtain hair from a deceased orc.
Obtain Hwyanthemon.
three-items-for-nuanda.reward: 1,000 XP each for up to six eligible PCs

k-r-k-caravan-run.title: The K-R-K Caravan Run
k-r-k-caravan-run.summary: Guard Billworth Turgen's caravan from Kirkilston to Raven's Pass and see its cargo safely delivered.
objectives: Protect the caravan and its travelers.
Deliver the surviving wagons to Raven's Pass.
k-r-k-caravan-run.reward: 15 gp each, a meal, and Billworth's offer of future work

plumb-lost-caverns.title: Plumb the Depths of the Lost Caverns
plumb-lost-caverns.summary: Explore the rediscovered Lost Caverns of Achaia on behalf of the mage Delk Whitewand.
objectives: Confirm and enter the Lost Caverns of Achaia.
Explore the caverns and recover their lost secrets.
Give any recovered scrolls and tomes to Delk.
plumb-lost-caverns.reward: 100 gp up front, 10 gp daily, useful potions, and other recovered treasure

reclaim-keep-on-borderlands.title: Reclaim the Keep on the Borderlands
reclaim-keep-on-borderlands.summary: Clear the goblins and bugbears from the abandoned keep that may stand over the ancient dwarf-hold Kharaz-Ankor.
objectives: Clear the keep of its goblin and bugbear occupants.
Investigate the possible entrance to the ancient dwarf-hold.
reclaim-keep-on-borderlands.reward: 25 gp daily for the party for up to 14 days, plus 5 gp per goblin tongue

construct-darkforest-fort.title: Help Reglar Ashbow Construct a Fort in the Darkforest
construct-darkforest-fort.summary: Help Reglar Ashbow construct a fort on the eastern shore of Donally Lake in the Darkforest.
objectives: Meet Reglar Ashbow and agree upon the work.
Travel to the eastern shore of Donally Lake.
Help construct and secure the fort.

find-urvan-and-narinza.title: Find Urvan and Narinza
find-urvan-and-narinza.summary: Determine what happened to Urvan and Narinza after they were separated from the party during the flight from Blightstone Pit.
objectives: Follow signs of the missing companions from Blightstone Pit.
Find Urvan and Narinza, or learn their fates.

free-slaytonthorpe.title: Free Slaytonthorpe from the Terror of Red Tusk
free-slaytonthorpe.summary: Fulfill Cromm's command to Neria by discovering the nature of Red Tusk and ending the terror afflicting Slaytonthorpe.
objectives: Learn who or what Red Tusk is.
Travel to Slaytonthorpe.
Free Slaytonthorpe from Red Tusk's terror.

investigate-cold-mouth.title: Investigate the Cold Mouth and the Deep Friends
investigate-cold-mouth.summary: Investigate the Cold Mouth named in the recovered Toothbreaker orders and identify the Deep Friends collecting captives there.
objectives: Locate the Cold Mouth north of Slaytonthorpe.
Identify Red Tusk and the Deep Friends.
Discover what happened to the captives taken there.

unmask-surface-hand.title: Unmask the Surface Hand Behind the Toothbreakers
unmask-surface-hand.summary: Use Algorn Druff's read of the recovered orders to learn whether a surface faction is directing the Toothbreakers, Red Tusk, and the Deep Friends.
objectives: Compare the two writing styles in the recovered orders.
Look for signs of the Basilisk's Claw, Cult of the Dragon, Zhentarim, or a witch-coven connection.
Identify the faction or agent using the Toothbreakers as muscle.

cleanse-blightstone-pit.title: Make Blightstone Pit Safe Again
cleanse-blightstone-pit.summary: Investigate the creature lairing beneath Blightstone Pit so the old quarry can stop threatening travelers and become useful again.
objectives: Locate the pit and confirm the creature's lair.
Learn whether the creature is connected to the orc attacks or only feeding on the chaos.
Drive off or destroy the creature and verify the quarry is safe.
cleanse-blightstone-pit.reward: Possible quarry rights, salvage, or treasure from prior victims

trace-vanished-elven-holds.title: Trace the Vanished Elven Holds
trace-vanished-elven-holds.summary: Follow Thurgan Newl's rumor that the drow may have been involved in the abandonment of the Glittering Canopy and Aelith-Calaer.
objectives: Gather testimony about the empty elven sites.
Determine whether drow activity around Narinza or Shade points to the vanished holds.
Find out whether the abandonment still threatens surface settlements.

map-kharaz-ankor-entrance.title: Map the Entrance to Kharaz-Ankor
map-kharaz-ankor-entrance.summary: After the Keep on the Borderlands is retaken, survey the passages beneath it and determine whether they truly lead to Kharaz-Ankor.
objectives: Secure the below-ground access after the keep is cleared.
Map the first safe route beneath the keep.
Bring Nolo Silvershaper proof of whether the passage leads to Kharaz-Ankor.

keep-cult-from-valashinaz.title: Keep the Cult from Valashinaz
keep-cult-from-valashinaz.summary: After the Lost Caverns of Achaia are opened, prevent dragon-cult interests from learning whether Valashinaz still waits beneath ruined Achaia.
objectives: Search recovered Achaian maps and tomes for references to Valashinaz.
Watch for Cult of the Dragon agents pursuing the same knowledge.
Secure or destroy the clues before they draw dangerous attention to Achaia.

explore-malviks-tower.title: Explore Malvik's Tower
explore-malviks-tower.summary: Locate the long-lost tower of Malvik the Mad in the forest north of Raven's Pass and investigate the extensive dungeons beneath it. Determine whether Malvik still survives as a lich and recover what can safely be taken from his trove.
explore-malviks-tower.giver: Rumors among travelers at Raven's Pass
objectives: Search east of the trail north of Raven's Pass for Malvik's lost tower.
Enter and explore the dungeons beneath the tower.
Determine whether Malvik became a lich and still inhabits the complex.
Return with proof of the tower's location and any safely recovered lore or treasure.
explore-malviks-tower.reward: Any gold and magic recovered from Malvik's unclaimed trove

trace-murfex-last-journey.title: Trace Murfex's Last Journey
trace-murfex-last-journey.summary: Retrace master glassworker Murfex Garrick's final journey toward Threshold. Discover where and how he died, recover his missing work, and determine whether his death was an accident or connected to his experimental glassware.
trace-murfex-last-journey.giver: Jelb Garrick and the Garrick family
objectives: Establish Murfex's intended route and reason for traveling to Threshold.
Find witnesses or physical traces from his final journey.
Determine the circumstances of Murfex's death.
Recover his experimental glassware, notes, or unfinished masterpiece for the Garrick family.
trace-murfex-last-journey.reward: To be arranged with the Garrick family

investigate-impurax-resurgence.title: Investigate the Rot in the Forbidden Zone
investigate-impurax-resurgence.summary: Enter the Forbidden Zone and investigate reports that the worship of Impurax, the Rotten God, has reappeared there. Identify the resurgent cult's leaders, learn what they are cultivating or corrupting, and prevent the blight from spreading beyond the ruined region.
objectives: Find evidence of Impurax's renewed worship in the Forbidden Zone.
Identify any Putrescalate cleric-druids or warriors of the Fanged Legion.
Discover the cult's source of pestilence, rot, or corrupted fungal life.
Destroy or contain the immediate threat and report what remains.

recover-calico-five-remains.title: Recover the Calico Five
recover-calico-five-remains.summary: Slengar Skullcrusher, sole survivor of the Calico Five, seeks closure for the companions lost during their incursion into Gundgathol. Retrace their expedition, find the site where a deep dragon destroyed the company, and recover the fallen clerics' remains and sacred possessions.
objectives: Find Slengar in Khalidheroneth and record his account of the expedition.
Retrace the Calico Five's route into Gundgathol.
Locate the place where the company encountered the deep dragon.
Recover Cheluthim's remains and the sacred possessions of the fallen clerics.
Determine whether the deep dragon still threatens the route.
recover-calico-five-remains.reward: To be arranged with Slengar Skullcrusher

harvest-xanderpetals.title: Harvest Xanderpetals
harvest-xanderpetals.summary: Gosterwick's supply of Xanderpetals is running dangerously low. Travel to the cold, barren lands where the plant grows, gather enough of its vivid red flowers to replenish the town's stores, and return before the remaining sedative tonic is exhausted.
objectives: Learn how to identify and safely harvest Xanderpetals.
Travel to the cold, barren lands where the plant grows.
Gather enough intact flowers to replenish Gosterwick's medicinal stores.
Return the Xanderpetals to Gosterwick before its remaining tonic is exhausted.
harvest-xanderpetals.reward: To be arranged with Gosterwick's healers

find-darkforest-giants-grave.title: Find the Giant's Grave
find-darkforest-giants-grave.summary: Search the heart of the Darkforest for the legendary grave of a giant slain by a red-scaled, horned dragon. Verify the old tale, discover what became of the dragon, and recover any relics buried with the giant.
find-darkforest-giants-grave.giver: Rumors among travelers at Raven's Pass
objectives: Gather accounts describing the giant, the horned dragon, and possible landmarks.
Travel into the heart of the Darkforest.
Locate and enter the giant's grave.
Determine whether the dragon survived or left descendants behind.
Recover proof of the grave's discovery and any safely transportable relics.
find-darkforest-giants-grave.reward: Any unclaimed treasure recovered from the grave

find-the-cold-mouth.title: Find the Cold Mouth
find-the-cold-mouth.summary: Follow the route recorded in the recovered Tooth-Breaker orders to locate the Cold Mouth, where Red-Tusk's orcs deliver kidnapped scholars, priests, craftspeople, and laborers to mysterious Deep Friends. Rescue any surviving captives and uncover who or what is collecting them.
objectives: Decode the crude route beginning near Slaytonthorpe.
Follow the dead stream and broken stones beyond the thorn hills.
Locate the watcher-mark and the entrance called the Cold Mouth.
Rescue captives awaiting collection by the Deep Friends.
Identify the Deep Friends and learn why they seek maps, sealed doors, old tunnels, and knowledge of the deep places.
find-the-cold-mouth.reward: Any supplies or treasure seized from the kidnappers, plus gratitude from rescued captives

find-doors-of-galduhr.title: Find the Doors of Galduhr
find-doors-of-galduhr.summary: Continue Bran Hammerspike's decades-long search for the fabled Doors of Galduhr, the lost entrance to the dwarven kingdom of Gundgathol. Retrace the expedition he undertook with Crynwyth Ironfist in the Moon Peaks, survive the elemental dangers they encountered, and find evidence that reveals the Doors' location.
objectives: Research Bran Hammerspike's expeditions in search of the Doors of Galduhr.
Retrace Bran and Crynwyth Ironfist's route through the Moon Peaks.
Find evidence of their encounter with a fire elemental.
Recover maps, markers, or records left during Bran's search.
Locate the Doors of Galduhr or establish the strongest surviving lead to them.
find-doors-of-galduhr.reward: Dwarven treasure or historical artifacts recovered during the expedition

establish-darkforest-fort.title: Establish the Darkforest Fort
establish-darkforest-fort.summary: Reglar 'The Ashbow' Lightstep is hiring able-bodied adventurers to help construct a fort in the Darkforest. Escort workers and supplies to the eastern shore of Donally Lake, secure the building site, and defend the expedition until the fort is usable.
objectives: Meet Reglar Lightstep and agree upon wages and responsibilities.
Assemble the workers, tools, and supplies needed for construction.
Travel approximately twelve miles southwest of Kirkilston to Donally Lake.
Survey and secure a defensible site on the lake's eastern shore.
Protect the workers until they complete a usable fortification.
establish-darkforest-fort.reward: Wages to be negotiated with Reglar Lightstep

gather-secrets-for-nimba.title: Gather Secrets for Nimba
gather-secrets-for-nimba.summary: Help Nimba Armstrong gather intelligence from the miners, guards, and travelers frequenting the Mason's Apron without exposing her life as a deep-cover spy. Identify information that could threaten the Nemere family's interests and report it to Nimba discreetly.
objectives: Meet Nimba discreetly at the Mason's Apron.
Observe conversations among the tavern's miners, guards, and travelers.
Identify secrets or developing events relevant to Nimba's interests.
Investigate the most credible lead without exposing Nimba's involvement.
Deliver the intelligence privately to Nimba while preserving her cover.
gather-secrets-for-nimba.reward: Nimba Armstrong's favor and access to selected intelligence from her network

find-missing-fevered.title: Find the Missing Fevered
find-missing-fevered.summary: Three of five Raven's Pass townsfolk afflicted by Dream Fever vanished during the previous week instead of being found in the surrounding fields and hills. Investigate Harl's suspicion that the disappearances are connected to Xanderpetals, recover any survivors, and discover what is taking the Fevered.
objectives: Question Harl and the families of the three missing townsfolk.
Search the fields and hills between the town and Raven's Pass.
Determine how Xanderpetals or Dream Fever relate to the disappearances.
Recover any survivors and stop whatever is taking the Fevered.
find-missing-fevered.reward: 75 gp pooled by the affected families, plus salvage rights

contain-soul-fungus-mordoom.title: Contain the Soul Fungus at Mordoom Keep
contain-soul-fungus-mordoom.summary: The Sporebane Brotherhood needs an expedition to the epicenter of Mordoom Keep's Soul Fungus outbreak. Assess whether the infection is spreading, trace Elowen Starshadow's missing mentor, and recover research or samples that may help contain the plague.
objectives: Survey Mordoom Keep for new fungal growth and infected wildlife.
Trace Elowen's mentor's final expedition into the keep.
Recover the mentor's research, remains, or both.
Secure a contained sample without looking directly at active fungal growths.
Return to the Sporebane Brotherhood before any infection can incubate.
contain-soul-fungus-mordoom.reward: Sporebane protective magic, treatment during incubation, and salvage rights

demon-beyond-east-tower.title: The Demon Beyond the East Tower
demon-beyond-east-tower.summary: Sixteen years ago, Kelda Rue's failed summoning dragged her master, Thelgarr Blackstaff, into another plane. Search his abandoned laboratory, determine whether he still lives, and prevent the summoned demon from finding a path back into Issenda.
objectives: Search Thelgarr Blackstaff's abandoned laboratory.
Reconstruct the summoning ritual that opened the planar passage.
Locate or safely reopen the passage to the plane that claimed Thelgarr.
Rescue Thelgarr, recover proof of his death, or permanently seal the breach.
demon-beyond-east-tower.reward: Kelda Rue's magical guidance and access to temple resources

rot-grey-company.title: Rot in the Grey Company
rot-grey-company.summary: Radloc Hudson suspects Darkeyes agents are bribing Grey Company guards and compromising Eastdale's caravans and warehouses. Investigate from outside the company, expose the corruption, and identify the Darkeyes mastermind without alerting potentially compromised personnel.
objectives: Identify compromised Grey Company guards.
Protect a vulnerable shipment or operate a decoy caravan.
Trace stolen goods through Eastdale's underground routes.
Identify the Darkeyes mastermind without exposing the investigation prematurely.
rot-grey-company.reward: To be negotiated with Radloc Hudson

captives-shrieken-mire.title: Captives of Shrieken Mire
captives-shrieken-mire.summary: Blue goblins have carried several townsfolk into Shrieken Mire, territory protected by lizardfolk who worship the ancient green dragon Inzeldrin.
objectives: Track the captives into the mire.
Learn why the goblins took them.
Rescue any survivors.
Avoid provoking Inzeldrin or turning the lizardfolk against Slaytonthorpe.
captives-shrieken-mire.reward: To be arranged with the rescued families; possible goblin salvage

silence-ford-isenduin.title: Silence at Ford-at-Isenduin
silence-ford-isenduin.summary: Billworth's promised follow-up work concerns caravans disappearing near Ford-at-Isenduin. Wagons have been found abandoned, but neither cargo nor travelers remain.
objectives: Investigate the abandoned wagons.
Identify who is controlling the ford.
Recover survivors and stolen cargo.
Make the crossing safe for future caravans.
silence-ford-isenduin.reward: Negotiable payment from Billworth, plus authorized salvage

failing-mythalvane.title: The Failing Mythalvane
failing-mythalvane.summary: The Mythalvane's magical protection has begun failing unpredictably. Rafell Riverwarden's surviving research points to a buried relay chamber outside Helix.
objectives: Locate the relay chamber.
Determine whether the failures result from decay or sabotage.
Recover or repair the damaged component.
Keep the failing defenses secret from Helix's enemies.
failing-mythalvane.reward: Seeker favor and restricted access to their historical records

sabotage-guardians-rest.title: Sabotage at Guardians' Rest
sabotage-guardians-rest.summary: Supplies have been poisoned and gate mechanisms damaged at Guardians' Rest shortly before caravan season. Evidence implicates Mordicar Justhand's household, but appears suspiciously convenient.
objectives: Secure the caravan station against further attacks.
Identify how the saboteur gained access.
Determine who benefits from discrediting Father Zistrus.
Prevent the dispute from disrupting trade between Kirkilston and Eastdale.
sabotage-guardians-rest.reward: Payment, free resupply, and future lodging at Guardians' Rest

thirsting-pool.title: The Thirsting Pool
thirsting-pool.summary: Phultarr's Pool, an inexplicable freshwater lake beyond living memory, is shrinking rapidly. Its retreating shoreline has exposed ancient stone steps descending beneath the water.
thirsting-pool.giver: Caravan masters crossing the Rauth Desert
objectives: Determine what is draining the lake.
Explore the newly exposed structure.
Restore the desert's freshwater supply.
Discover whether the pool is Demetra's Tears, Oaxus' Blood, or something older.
thirsting-pool.reward: Recovered relics and the gratitude of desert travelers

shrine-fire-burns-hot.title: When the Shrine Fire Burns Hot
shrine-fire-burns-hot.summary: The eternal flame at Sir Ardan Hearthward's shrine has begun burning unnaturally hot, an omen of danger emerging from deeper in the Blanryde Hills. Follow the warning, rescue those endangered by it, and confront the wilderness threat.
objectives: Gather reports of missing travelers and unusual activity.
Follow forgotten cairns and old sheep paths into the Blanryde Hills.
Find and rescue the missing.
Eliminate the wilderness threat or clearly mark its lair.
shrine-fire-burns-hot.reward: Sir Ardan's aid, friendship, and knowledge of forgotten paths

investigate-barrowmaze-undead.title: Stem the Dead from Barrowmaze
investigate-barrowmaze-undead.summary: Undead are emerging from the Cumerian barrows beneath the marsh and reaching the outskirts of Helix and Bogtown. Find the source of the outbreak and reduce the threat before more dead reach settled streets.
investigate-barrowmaze-undead.giver: The authorities or temples of Helix and Bogtown
objectives: Travel to Barrowmaze and identify the routes by which undead are leaving the tombs.
Determine what has caused the recent increase in undead activity.
Destroy or seal the immediate source of the outbreak.
Report which surrounding settlements remain at risk.
investigate-barrowmaze-undead.reward: A negotiated civic or temple payment, plus salvage from cleared tombs

recover-barrowmaze-runic-tablets.title: Recover the Runic Tablets
recover-barrowmaze-runic-tablets.summary: Runic Tablets buried with the Cumerian dead were meant to ward off tomb-robbers, but folk tales claim that reading them brings a curse. Recover one or more tablets for a scholar while surviving whatever safeguards remain in the barrows.
recover-barrowmaze-runic-tablets.giver: A scholar or antiquarian in Helix
objectives: Locate an intact Cumerian burial containing a Runic Tablet.
Recover the tablet without destroying its inscriptions.
Determine whether the tablet curse is real and how it can be contained.
Deliver the tablet to the patron without attracting tomb-robbers or undead.
recover-barrowmaze-runic-tablets.reward: Payment for an intact tablet and expert help with any resulting curse

hunt-darkforest-troll.title: Hunt the Trolls of the Darkforest
hunt-darkforest-troll.summary: Travelers claim that trolls roam the Darkforest, threatening villages and charcoal camps that depend on its timber and game. Find out whether the rumor describes one predator or a larger danger and stop the attacks if possible.
hunt-darkforest-troll.giver: The Hamlet Watch of Kirkilston or nearby forest villages
objectives: Collect reliable accounts of recent troll sightings or attacks.
Track the troll threat through the forest bogs and rough terrain.
Determine how many trolls are active and where they lair.
Drive off or destroy the threat and warn the forest settlements.
hunt-darkforest-troll.reward: A community payment, salvage from abandoned camps, and local goodwill

map-horgrim-tunnel-routes.title: Map the Horgrim Tunnels
map-horgrim-tunnel-routes.summary: Ancient tunnels beneath the Darkforest may connect the surface to the Underdark, the Forbidden Zone, and lands beneath Slaytonthorpe. Chart a safe initial route before someone else uses the forgotten passages for an attack or kidnapping.
map-horgrim-tunnel-routes.giver: A ranger, caravan master, or settlement threatened by the tunnels
objectives: Locate a surviving entrance to the Horgrim Tunnels.
Survey the first section and record landmarks, hazards, and branching passages.
Determine whether the old underground river is truly dry or has been diverted.
Return with a usable map and warning about any active occupants.
map-horgrim-tunnel-routes.reward: Payment for the map and ordinary salvage recovered during the survey

uncover-gosterwick-logothete.title: Uncover the Green Lady’s Secret Logothete
uncover-gosterwick-logothete.summary: Whispers in Gosterwick describe an unlisted fourth Logothete who hires adventurers to retrieve private acquisitions from Arden Vul. Find the hidden employer, learn what is being sought, and decide whether the arrangement should remain secret.
uncover-gosterwick-logothete.giver: A discreet informant at the Yellow Cloak
objectives: Identify the unlisted Logothete and establish who currently works for them.
Learn what item or information Lady Alexia wants recovered from Arden Vul.
Determine whether the acquisition is legal, dangerous, or connected to a rival faction.
Choose whether to expose the scheme, accept the work, or prevent the acquisition.
uncover-gosterwick-logothete.reward: A confidential payment, access to Gosterwick contacts, or leverage over Lady Alexia

investigate-red-thicket-ambushes.title: Break the Red Thicket Ambushes
investigate-red-thicket-ambushes.summary: Gnolls and orcs use the Red Thicket Pass and the Ford-at-the-River-Isenduin to waylay merchants. Find the force coordinating the ambushes and make the trade route safer without simply moving the danger to another crossing.
investigate-red-thicket-ambushes.giver: Merchants and caravan leaders using the Northern Reaches trade route
objectives: Examine recent ambush sites for a common pattern or command structure.
Protect or bait a caravan to identify the attackers’ staging area.
Locate the gnoll or orc leader directing the attacks.
Break the ambush network or negotiate a safer arrangement for travelers.
investigate-red-thicket-ambushes.reward: Caravan payments, recovered cargo, and a reputation with Northern Reaches merchants

seek-the-deep-chaymyn-gate.title: Seek the Sealed Gates of Deep Chaymyn
seek-the-deep-chaymyn-gate.summary: Deep Chaymyn is said to be sealed behind massive dwarven bulkheads and powerful wards, yet its inhabitants supposedly have not needed the surface for centuries. Find evidence of the hold’s condition and learn why its gates remain closed.
seek-the-deep-chaymyn-gate.giver: A historian of the Northern Reaches or a dwarf seeking news of Deep Chaymyn
objectives: Gather surviving records or testimony about the hold’s entrances.
Reach a sealed gate without provoking the wards or the hold’s defenders.
Determine whether Deep Chaymyn is thriving, abandoned, or under an internal threat.
Return with proof of the hold’s condition or a message from its inhabitants.
seek-the-deep-chaymyn-gate.reward: Dwarven patronage, historical payment, or a negotiated trade with Deep Chaymyn

recover-achaian-inscriptions.title: Recover the Achaian Inscriptions
recover-achaian-inscriptions.summary: Muirron the Magician collects Archaians, Archomancy, spellbooks, scrolls, and ancient lore. Bring him a safe, legible inscription from a ruin or dungeon without allowing its magic or custodians to follow the party home.
objectives: Learn which Achaian inscription or subject Muirron considers valuable.
Locate a suitable inscription in a ruin or dungeon.
Copy or recover the writing without damaging its context or triggering a magical defense.
Deliver the result to Muirron in Eastdale, Ironguard Motte, or on the road.
recover-achaian-inscriptions.reward: A negotiated payment, translation, or useful magical lore from Muirron’s collection

protect-glickstonehome-patrols.title: Protect the Glickstonehome Patrols
protect-glickstonehome-patrols.summary: The Flickerdiggles clan patrols the warrens, fields, and pastures around Glickstonehome against brigands and beasts. Join a patrol, identify the source of a growing threat, and keep the surface village safe long enough for the clan to respond.
objectives: Learn the patrol routes and recent signs of brigands or dangerous beasts.
Escort a patrol through the exposed fields and nearby hills.
Track the threat to its camp, lair, or source of supplies.
Protect the warrens and report whether the danger is likely to return.
protect-glickstonehome-patrols.reward: Gnome hospitality, a negotiated payment, and future access to Glickstonehome’s patrol network

investigate-guardian-shrine-fire.title: Test the Guardian Shrine’s Fire
investigate-guardian-shrine-fire.summary: Sir Ardan Hearthward tends a lonely Demetran shrine in the hills, where travelers say the eternal fire burns hotter when danger is near. Visit the shrine, learn what has disturbed its flame, and help Ardan protect those who rely on its shelter.
objectives: Travel to the shrine and observe the fire’s unusual behavior.
Investigate nearby cairns, paths, and signs of orcspawn or other threats.
Determine whether the danger is approaching the shrine or only passing through the hills.
Help Sir Ardan keep the shrine safe and the eternal flame burning.
investigate-guardian-shrine-fire.reward: Sir Ardan’s steadfast aid, shelter on future journeys, and a negotiated shrine blessing

descend-beneath-undalan.title: Search for Benediction Beneath Undalan
descend-beneath-undalan.summary: Investigate the tradition that Benediction, an ancient city older than Undalan, lies in ruins beneath the settlement below Phandalin.
descend-beneath-undalan.giver: A historian or treasure-seeker in Phandalin
objectives: Find reliable evidence for the ruins of Benediction beneath Undalan.
Locate a safe route into the buried city.
Return with a map, inscription, or other proof of what lies below.
descend-beneath-undalan.reward: Payment for verified discoveries and any safely recovered antiquities

scout-thundertree-netherese-ruins.title: Scout the Ruins of Thundertree
scout-thundertree-netherese-ruins.summary: Survey the ruins of Thundertree, destroyed by the green dragon Inzeldrin, and determine whether the deeper Netherese ruins beneath the village can be reached safely.
objectives: Reach the ruins northeast of Slaytonthorpe.
Determine whether Inzeldrin or other threats still occupy the site.
Locate an accessible entrance to the deeper Netherese ruins.
Return with a report and any non-dangerous evidence of the older settlement.
scout-thundertree-netherese-ruins.reward: A research fee and payment for recoverable Netherese records

reopen-gauntwood-way.title: Reopen the Way to the Gauntwood Galleries
reopen-gauntwood-way.summary: Use the newly surveyed passages beneath the Keep on the Borderlands to identify whether a route can be reopened toward the dwarven Gauntwood Galleries.
objectives: Compare the Keep's underground map with dwarven records of the Gauntwood Galleries.
Find and clear the first blocked section of the old route.
Mark hazards and usable camps for a future dwarven expedition.
reopen-gauntwood-way.reward: Dwarven coin, supplies, and a negotiated share of recovered materials

guard-citadel-silver-caravan.title: Guard the Citadel Silver Caravan
guard-citadel-silver-caravan.summary: Protect a dwarven caravan traveling between Citadel Silver and the Northern Reaches along the route where earlier Crumwich caravans suffered a deadly gnoll ambush.
objectives: Join the caravan and learn its planned route and cargo.
Identify signs of flind-led gnoll activity before the ambush point.
Deliver the caravan safely to its destination.
guard-citadel-silver-caravan.reward: Dwarven pay, trade goods, and future contracts from Citadel Silver

recover-silent-diamond-record.title: Recover the Secret of Silent Diamond
recover-silent-diamond-record.summary: Investigate the western Middenmark village of Silent Diamond and learn whether Thoras Goldpanner's legendary fist-sized diamond left a surviving trail or hidden claim.
recover-silent-diamond-record.giver: A collector of dwarven mining history
objectives: Establish what records remain of Thoras Goldpanner's discovery.
Determine who knew the diamond's location before Thoras died.
Recover the missing record, map, or other proof without provoking a local feud.
recover-silent-diamond-record.reward: A negotiated fee for the recovered history, with a finder’s share if the diamond is located

defend-westkeep-watchtower.title: Defend the Watchtower of Westkeep
defend-westkeep-watchtower.summary: Help the fortified monastery at Westkeep prepare for threats against its apprentice clerics, guards, and religious studies.
objectives: Assess the monastery's defenses and the vulnerable wooden staircase.
Identify who or what is threatening the Watchtower.
Help secure the apprentices and hold the monastery through the danger.
defend-westkeep-watchtower.reward: Temple support, healing, and a formal favor from the Watchtower

restore-hoskighee-trade-road.title: Restore the Hoskighee Trade Road
restore-hoskighee-trade-road.summary: Help Hoskighee maintain its coal and limestone trade with Helix, Bogtown, Wyrdwood, and Ironguard Motte despite dangers in the Moon Peaks foothills.
objectives: Learn which section of the trade road has become unsafe.
Escort a shipment or repair the route through the foothills.
Identify and resolve the threat disrupting trade.
restore-hoskighee-trade-road.reward: A merchant's payment and a discount on Hoskighee coal or limestone

map-bauthwaf-border-tunnels.title: Map the Edge of the Bauthwaf
map-bauthwaf-border-tunnels.summary: Chart a route along the edge of the Bauthwaf, the network of tunnels around Menzoberranzan patrolled by elite drow riding driders.
map-bauthwaf-border-tunnels.giver: A surface guide seeking a safer Underdark route
objectives: Find a defensible approach to the Bauthwaf.
Map landmarks and crossings without drawing the patrols' attention.
Return with a route that distinguishes safe passages from drow-controlled ground.
map-bauthwaf-border-tunnels.reward: Payment for the map and a share of any safely recovered Underdark salvage

find-shallows-surface-route.title: Find a Route into the Shallows
find-shallows-surface-route.summary: Locate a usable entrance to the Shallows, the upper portion of the Underdark, and document the first stretch well enough for a cautious expedition.
objectives: Identify a surface entrance leading into the Shallows.
Survey the first safe landmarks and hazards below ground.
Return with a route description and evidence that the passage reaches the Upperdark.
find-shallows-surface-route.reward: A research fee, mapping supplies, and an expeditionary share of recovered treasure

seek-tien-lung-contact.title: Find a Contact in Tien Lung
seek-tien-lung-contact.summary: Establish a trustworthy trade or information contact in Tien Lung, the distant city known for commerce, political intrigue, and indulgence.
seek-tien-lung-contact.giver: A Northern Reaches trader with distant interests
objectives: Learn which Tien Lung merchant, envoy, or household can be trusted.
Carry a sealed introduction or trade proposal to the city.
Return with a reliable contact and the terms of future dealings.
seek-tien-lung-contact.reward: A commission on future trade and payment for a successful introduction

investigate-donelduns-den.title: Investigate Doneldun's Den
investigate-donelduns-den.summary: Learn why the dragon turtle Doneldun has remained silent since the last verified conversation with Halathra Moonbeam, and determine whether a new danger is disturbing Lake Donally.
investigate-donelduns-den.giver: A Demetran druid or lakeside community
objectives: Find the site where Halathra Moonbeam reportedly held palaver with Doneldun.
Determine whether the dragon turtle is still present and why it has withdrawn.
Investigate threats affecting Lake Donally or the ruins around Aelith-Calaer.
Return with an account that can guide future contact or prevent a lake disaster.
investigate-donelduns-den.reward: A favor from the Demetran faithful, safe passage on Lake Donally, and any recovered lake treasure

reclaim-golbrandur-outer-gate.title: Reclaim Golbrandur’s Outer Gate
reclaim-golbrandur-outer-gate.summary: Aid Elbramoth Battlebeard in opening a defensible approach to Golbrandur while the dracolich and dragon cultists remain entrenched in the ancient dwarven city-fortress.
objectives: Reach the outer approach to Golbrandur without drawing the full attention of the entrenched cult.
Locate a defensible gate, breach, or forgotten service entrance.
Disrupt the defenders long enough for Elbramoth’s forces to establish a foothold.
Report what the expedition learned about the dracolich’s defenses.
reclaim-golbrandur-outer-gate.reward: Dwarven payment, military favor, and a share of any treasure recovered from the secured approach

chart-barakuir-iron-road.title: Chart the Iron Road to Barakuir
chart-barakuir-iron-road.summary: Trace the ancient tunnel connection between Altgrimmr and the duergar stronghold of Barakuir, documenting what remains passable and what dangers now occupy the route.
chart-barakuir-iron-road.giver: A historian or tunnel-master of Altgrimmr
objectives: Locate the surviving entrance to the old Altgrimmr–Barakuir tunnel route.
Map a safe section and identify collapses, sealed gates, or hostile outposts.
Recover a surviving marker or record proving how the route was used.
Return with a map that can support future dwarven expeditions.
chart-barakuir-iron-road.reward: Dwarven coin, mapping privileges, and access to an old route through the mountains

solve-phultarrs-pool.title: Solve the Mystery of Phultarr's Pool
solve-phultarrs-pool.summary: Investigate the inexplicable freshwater lake in the Rauth Desert, called both Demetra’s Tears and Oaxus’ Blood, and learn why it has never run dry.
solve-phultarrs-pool.giver: A desert caravan master or rival priesthood
objectives: Reach Phultarr’s Pool and document its water, shores, and nearby ruins or signs.
Identify whether the lake is natural, magical, or maintained by a hidden power.
Determine what the names Demetra’s Tears and Oaxus’ Blood mean to local travelers.
Return with a safe-water route or warning about a danger connected to the pool.
solve-phultarrs-pool.reward: Desert guides’ gratitude, a reliable oasis route, and any relic revealed by the investigation

protect-thicket-wood.title: Protect the Thicket Wood
protect-thicket-wood.summary: Find out whether the legendary treants or wood elves of the Red Thicket are reacting to illegal logging, and prevent a conflict from closing the road through Raven’s Pass.
protect-thicket-wood.giver: Raven’s Pass woodcutters or a St. Ygg road official
objectives: Identify who is cutting in the Thicket Wood and why.
Locate signs of treant or wood-elf intervention without provoking it.
Negotiate terms that protect the oldest trees while keeping the road supplied.
Stop any immediate threat before the forest retaliates against Raven’s Pass.
protect-thicket-wood.reward: Safe passage through the Red Thicket, timber rights or supplies, and a forest faction’s cautious goodwill

secure-coalscuttle-supply.title: Secure the Coal Hills Supply Line
secure-coalscuttle-supply.summary: Keep the miners of Coalscuttle supplied and their coal shipment moving after a threat interrupts the route from the Coal Hills.
objectives: Learn what has interrupted the road between Coalscuttle and its buyers.
Escort tools, food, or a coal shipment through the threatened stretch.
Discover whether the danger is banditry, a monster, or a rival mining interest.
Restore a dependable route without collapsing the camp’s fragile economy.
secure-coalscuttle-supply.reward: Coal, miners’ pay, and a continuing discount on fuel or metalwork

free-the-branderscar-prisoner.title: Free the Prisoner of Branderscar
free-the-branderscar-prisoner.summary: Determine why a prisoner in Branderscar claims to possess evidence about a hidden threat in the Fangorran Range, then decide whether the prisoner deserves rescue.
free-the-branderscar-prisoner.giver: A worried relative or an intermediary in Rosen
objectives: Identify the prisoner and learn the charge that placed them in Branderscar.
Verify the prisoner’s claim without exposing an innocent accomplice.
Reach the mountain prison or arrange a lawful extraction.
Decide whether to free the prisoner, expose a greater crime, or leave them confined.
free-the-branderscar-prisoner.reward: A useful contact in Rosen, legal favor, and whatever evidence the prisoner can safely surrender

escort-forgehome-ore-train.title: Escort the Forgehome Ore Train
escort-forgehome-ore-train.summary: Protect a shipment of smelted ore traveling from Forgehome toward Citadel Silver and learn who is testing the friendly trade route between the two dwarven communities.
escort-forgehome-ore-train.giver: Forgehome mine factors or Citadel Silver merchants
objectives: Join the ore shipment at Forgehome and establish the route’s weak points.
Protect the miners, wagons, and ore through the Shallows.
Identify whether attacks are opportunistic, duergar-directed, or politically motivated.
Deliver the shipment and report any evidence of a wider threat.
escort-forgehome-ore-train.reward: Dwarven wages, masterwork goods at a discount, and trust from both communities

expose-darkeyes-sewer-route.title: Expose the Darkeyes’ Sewer Route
expose-darkeyes-sewer-route.summary: Help uncover how Retep Garnetstone’s Darkeyes move contraband and people through the sewers beneath Eastdale and the Middenmark while avoiding a war with the city’s spies.
expose-darkeyes-sewer-route.giver: A threatened merchant, rival guild, or lawkeeper
objectives: Confirm that Retep’s relic shop is a cover for a wider smuggling network.
Trace one discreet passage through the Eastdale or Middenmark sewers.
Determine which goods or people are being moved and who benefits.
Choose whether to expose the route, exploit it, or use it to protect someone endangered by the Red Laws.
expose-darkeyes-sewer-route.reward: Information, black-market access, or a bounty from the party that commissioned the investigation

recover-men-of-the-motte-journal.title: Recover the Men of the Motte Journal
recover-men-of-the-motte-journal.summary: Find the missing field journal from Muirron Artelba’s adventuring days with the Men of the Motte before its account of a forgotten site is sold, altered, or destroyed.
objectives: Learn where Muirron last saw the Men of the Motte journal.
Track the journal through collectors, caravaners, or an abandoned cache.
Recover the pages without allowing a dangerous site description to circulate.
Return the journal to Muirron and determine whether its location is worth investigating.
recover-men-of-the-motte-journal.reward: Muirron’s research aid, a spell or antiquarian service, and a share of any safe discovery named in the journal
